I felt so inadequate for being slightly overwhelmed by all the names and actions without intermissions, which would make me re-read paragraphs scratching my head "wait what just happened, why…?". I blamed the language barrier, but seeing other ppl reporting the same made me feel better.
I apologize for not having to say anything more substancial or useful, but that really strained my focus and I kinda skipped through some parts because it wasn't easy to follow.
The idea is a blast though, I'm intrigued by MC&D, I like espionage and such stuff, I like all the different MTFs, their origins and tales but.
